raw_segments.text: I do deem it now a most meaning thing that that old Greek Prometheus who made men, they
say, should have been a blacksmith and animated them with fire.
For what's made in fire must properly belong to fire, and so hell's probable.
This must be the remainder the Greek made the Africans of.
Carpenter, when he's through with that buckle, tell him to forge a pair of steel shoulder
There's a peddler aboard with a crushing pack.
